candidate.name: Bomana War Cemetery
candidate.note: War cemetery: the largest WWII Commonwealth cemetery in PNG, 3,824 graves, mostly from the Kokoda campaign; free and open daily, 19 km out of town.

candidate.name: Kerema
candidate.note: Town: the capital of Gulf Province on the Gulf of Papua coast, a basic base for the Gulf with a few hotels, reached by the Hiritano Highway or by air.

candidate.name: Kokoda Track
candidate.note: Trail: the 96 km WWII trek over the Owen Stanley Range from Owers' Corner north to the Kokoda Valley, usually 6-12 days (its northern half lies in Oro Province).

candidate.name: National Parliament of Papua New Guinea
candidate.wiki: National Parliament of Papua New Guinea
candidate.note: Landmark: the parliament building in Waigani, designed on a Maprik haus tambaran; visitors see the exterior, with guided tours outside sitting days.

candidate.name: Port Moresby Golf Club
candidate.note: Golf course: a club course opposite the government buildings, open to visitors, with a restaurant in the clubhouse (a private operator).
